name: split-reading-notes
title: Split Reading Notes
description: Edward Tufte-style margin notes layout with annotations aligned adjacent to corresponding prose paragraphs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Marginal Annotation Reading: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
